description: Monotonic descent of the remaining learned tied-token ranks below the retained rank-4 representation, one runner-mediated micro-trial per rank.
proposal: Family: token representation. Retained incumbent is attempt-0056 with 2886 parameters at 99.310000%, a +0.310000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0056, rank-4 learned tied token codes (2886, 99.31%); the most recent failed result is attempt-0052, rank 5 under the 45000-step schedule, an optimization failure ending at 98.30% validation; 7 prior token-representation macro attempts. Hypothesis: a still-lower tied token identity subspace may qualify because rank 4 retained all ten digit and five structural token identities under the successful factorized-position architecture. This is token-subspace representational compression, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. Ordering: test ranks 3, then 2, then 1 in descending order, always from the runner-retained source. Acceptance/rollback: the runner alone retains only a qualified strictly smaller candidate and restores the incumbent otherwise. Stop after the first scored discard or error because it changes the monotonic lower-rank eligibility rule, on no eligible rank, or at the declared cap. Maximum micro-trials: 3. Compute budget: at most 225000 training steps and three configured runner training windows; every train, verify, retain, and discard action occurs exclusively through run_attempt.py. This is more informative than jumping to rank 2 because rank 3 locates the immediate remaining capacity boundary.
summary: Attempted tied-token ranks 3, 2, and 1 in descending order under the declared rank-4 frontier; micro-0001 at rank 3 completed 75000 training steps in 22.8 minutes but was an optimization failure (validation remained at or below 0.10%, no checkpoint or official score), so ranks 2 and 1 were ineligible under the monotonic stopping rule. No micro-trial was retained; the frontier remains rank 4 at 2886 parameters and 99.310000%. Compute used: 75000 training steps. Stopped because the first recorded optimization-failure error changed the declared lower-rank eligibility rule, as documented in AUTOMATION_TRIGGER.json.
